forces.title: Increased Excise Duty Imposes Cost Burden on Tobacco Products
forces.description: The Union Budget 2026-27 introduced an excise duty on tobacco products, effective from February 2026, with the explicit aim of supporting union excise duty collections in FY27. This governmental fiscal measure directly increases the cost base for manufacturers and distributors within the Tobacco Products sector. The imposition of this duty is expected to translate into higher consumer prices, potentially impacting demand, sales volumes, and ultimately pressuring profit margins across the industry. This policy represents a significant, direct regulatory headwind for the sector.
